items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Dinah Shore was on the bill as extra added attraction.

ctx.x: So I never will forget this. Charley was booked to go in the Paramount Theatre, and Dinah Shore was on the bill as extra added attraction. Well, I'm a little ahead of myself, but to get the band set for this particular engagement at the Paramount in New York City, he took a job in a theatre uptown in the Bronx called the Valencia Theatre. So

Charlie called me, and he says, "Horace, I don't know what we're gonna do. Ford Leary, my trombonist and vocalist, has suffered a severe case of laryngitis." He says, "You think you could find me a singer? Go down to Harlem somewhere, down to the Apollo Theatre, and find me a singer." I said, "Well, I'll try." So I got in my car and I drove down, and to make a long story short, after enquiring around, guess who I came back with?
